name: Arukenimon
main_effect:
＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
[On Play] Reveal the top 5 cards of your deck. Trash 2 purple cards among them. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
[On Deletion] From your trash and without paying the cost, you may play 1 Tamer card with [Myotismon] in its text and without the same name as any of your Tamers.
